name: nagarsetu
description: NagarSetu (G-02 GovFix) - Configurable Municipal Grievance Resolution Workflow Engine for Pune

scripts.build: rm -rf .next/cache && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db} prisma generate && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db} prisma db push --skip-generate && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db} tsx prisma/seed.ts --if-empty && next build
scripts.start: DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db} prisma db push --skip-generate && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db} tsx prisma/seed.ts --if-empty && next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p ${PORT:-3000}
